description: Tauri v2 Windows debug runs overflow the main thread stack when many commands, permissions, and add-ons are generated into the context, based on https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/9882.
prompt: My Tauri app migrated from v1 runs on macOS and Linux, but Windows 11 dies in debug with `thread 'main' has overflowed its stack`. If I remove random permissions or add-ons it sometimes starts, but I need those features for the app.
